channel.description: Updates for Device Performance Monitor — live memory, CPU, thread and frame-rate monitoring from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
• What's New screen — A new modal shows what changed after each update, and any time from the app menu.
  • Includes everything from 1.1.0: AI session analysis (Claude / GPT / Gemini) with per-screen charts and token counts, saved session history you can reopen and analyze later, and screen tracking that follows React Native and Compose/Fragment screens.
